rules.statement: Each Goose session mounts exactly one explicitly registered host workspace read-write.
rules.title: Goose gets exactly one registered workspace
rules.why: Bounds Goose file authority to the workspace deliberately selected for that session.

rules.statement: Goose containers use a read-only root filesystem.
rules.title: Goose root filesystem is read-only
rules.why: Limits container-side mutation outside the delegated persistent surfaces.

rules.statement: Goose containers drop Linux capabilities and use `no-new-privileges`.
rules.title: Goose drops Linux privileges
rules.why: Reduces privileges available inside the session container.

rules.statement: Goose receives no access to unrelated WSL or Windows directories unless they are deliberately registered as the selected workspace.
rules.title: Goose cannot see unrelated host directories
rules.why: Prevents accidental expansion of the agent file-access boundary.

rules.statement: Broad workspace paths such as `/`, `/home`, `$HOME`, `/mnt` and `/mnt/c` are rejected by the wrapper.
rules.title: Goose rejects broad workspace roots
rules.why: Prevents registering host-wide paths that would defeat workspace isolation.

rules.statement: The selected Goose workspace is mounted at a stable container path under `/workspaces/NAME`.
rules.title: Goose workspace container path
rules.why: Gives sessions a predictable container-side workspace location independent of the host path.

rules.statement: The selected workspace is delegated authority: Goose can edit or delete files inside it and can modify its Git repository.
rules.title: Selected Goose workspace is delegated authority
rules.why: Makes the consequence of granting a workspace explicit to operators and reviewers.

rules.statement: Review Goose changes before committing or pushing them.
rules.title: Review Goose changes before publishing
rules.why: Keeps publication of agent-made repository changes under human control.

rules.statement: The launcher exposes native Goose provider, model and extension configuration without an application-specific provider whitelist, forced public credentials or implicit public-provider fallback. Configuration and connection checks run without a host project mount; Goose settings remain in its persistent home volume.
rules.title: Operator-selected Goose connections
rules.why: Supports both local confidential workflows and explicitly selected remote providers while preserving one-workspace isolation.
